title: Resolution urging Albany to extend office-to-housing tax break deadlines
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature and Governor to extend the commencement and completion deadlines for the Affordable Housing from Commercial Conversions tax incentive program. The program currently requires conversions to begin by June 30, 2026 for the longest 35-year tax exemption and to finish by December 31, 2039. The Council argues more time would let more office-to-residential projects, including affordable units, qualify for the incentive.
